notes.title: Celebrating 12 years of Draknek & Friends - Steam Publisher Sale
notes.content: [p]Have you heard the news? This week* is the 12th anniversary of Draknek and Friends! 🎉[/p][p][i]*technically it's tricky to pinpoint the exact date we were founded, but it's been 12 years since the first release of our first game, [url="https://sokobond.com/"]Sokobond[/url]. So this seems the most plausible time to celebrate our anniversary![/i][/p][p]With the 5 year anniversary of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1052990/A_Monsters_Expedition/"]A Monster's Expedition[/url] next month too, we have a bunch of exciting things happening this month and next. Check them out:[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//37052424/05b2c24b1803e02223891e432863b37ecf209edf.png"][/img][/p][h2]12th Anniversary Sale on Steam[/h2][p]To kick things off, here on Steam we're running an official publisher sale for the next two weeks.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/draknek/sale/Draknek12Years" style="button"]store.steampowered.com/publisher/draknek/sale/Draknek12Years[/url][/p][p][/p][p]This sale includes all the games we've developed, published, and the new demo for our upcoming game, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/"]Spooky Express[/url].[/p][p]It also features some of our deepest discounts yet, so now is an excellent time to pick up a new game.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//37052424/36ffa0a84db758d7cacddecbbcb07b32c2035e82.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Humble Bundle - Draknek & Friends: 12 Years of Great Puzzle Games![/h2][p]Running until September 19th, this [url="https://www.humblebundle.com/games/draknek-and-friends-12th-anniversary-celebration"]12th Anniversary Draknek & Friends Humble Bundle[/url] is the first time you've ever been able to get all our games in one place this cheaply. These bundles support The Trevor Project - the leading suicide prevention and crisis intervention nonprofit organization for LGBTQ+ young people. Pay what you like, get some great games, and support a charity along the way. The bundles are:[/p][list][*][p][b]$5 for 4 Draknek & Friends games[/b][/p][list][*][p](Electrifying Incident, Sokobond, Cosmic Express and A Good Snowman)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]$10 for 6 Draknek & Friends games[/b][/p][list][*][p](the previously included games, Sokobond Express, and Bonfire Peaks)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]$15 for the Entire 8 game bundle[/b][/p][list][*][p](the previously included games, LOK Digital, and A Monster's Expedition[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//37052424/b9f7a0bfc6053c7de6fa00eb7ae45b05c70e5203.png"][/img][/p][h2]12 Years of Draknek, 12 Free Copies of Draknek Games![/h2][p]To celebrate 12 years, we're also giving away 12 copies of Draknek & Friends games. To enter, sign up to our mailing list by heading to [url="https://giveaway.draknek.org/"]this link[/url], and winners will be chosen on Friday 5th September.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]In other Draknek & Friends news:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://spooky.express/"]Spooky Express[/url] will be launching October 21st, don't forget to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/"]wishlist on Steam[/url], and pre-order on [url="http://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=express.spooky"]Android[/url] or [url="http://apps.apple.com/app/id6738424828"]iOS[/url]![/p][/*][*][p]Bonfire Peaks is taking part in the [url="https://itch.io/b/2979/play-for-peace-games-for-palestine-2025-charity-bundle"]Play for Peace - Games for Palestine 2025 Charity Bundle[/url] on itch.io[/p][/*][*][p]Sokobond Express is taking part in the [url="https://itch.io/b/3171/game-devs-of-color-support-bundle"]Game Devs of Color Support Bundle[/url] on itch.io[/p][/*][*][p]The [url="https://grants.draknek.org/"]Draknek New Voices Puzzle Grant[/url] is accepting applications until September 28th[/p][/*][/list][p]That's all for now! Until next time.[/p]

notes.title: We're excited to announce the next game from Draknek & Friends: Spooky Express
notes.content:
Hey there!

If you enjoyed [i]Sokobond[/i], then you might also enjoy what we've been working on lately here at Draknek & Friends.

Announcing: [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/]Spooky Express[/url][/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7938465/83e82ab61856c744ba366a8e814e5b0fc8468bd8.png[/img]

Plan the train route for the world’s spookiest theme park!
All the passengers are all just [i]dying[/i] to ride the Spooky Express.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7938465/ae096275ed36a1d1ae8b7fd51d4e66ba6d0c68c1.gif[/img]

Pick up the creepy cryptids and drop them at their destinations around the park. But be careful! Don’t let them scare or bite the human passengers. Stay [i]on track[/i] of the situation or you’ll have a [i]grave[/i] problem.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/

Spooky Express is great follow-up to our other award-winning thinky puzzle game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/583270/Cosmic_Express/]Cosmic Express[/url] and will feature over 100 unique levels with countless monsters, maps and mechanics.

If that sounds like something you might be interested in, please give us a wishlist on Steam, or share the trailer below.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uewJWzD6s10

...And that's not all. If you want to hear even more about Spooky Express, we've just released a special episode of the [url=https://www.draknek.org/podcast]Draknek & Friends Official Podcast[/url]. Tune in wherever you get your podcasts to hear creative director Alan Hazelden and producer Syrenne McNulty chat to the level designer Lucas Le Slo about the development of the game, and some of the other projects he's involved in.

Until next time 👋

notes.title: New Game Announcement: LOK Digital
notes.content:
Hey there!

If you enjoyed playing Sokobond, we think you'll love what we've been working on lately. Combining creative [i]thinky puzzles[/i], intuitive mechanics, and an elegant hand-drawn art style... We're pleased to announce the new game we're publishing this year is [b]LOK Digital[/b].

Based on the critically acclaimed puzzle book LOK by Blaž Urban Gracar, in LOK Digital you'll learn world-changing words, master their mind-bending effects, and help the Lok creatures thrive in this charming puzzle adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7938465/bce513bc27c8e6253357fccaffc4b64eb84dff6f.gif[/img]
[i]Are you excited to meet the LOK creatures and learn their cryptic language?[/i]

Discover magical words, and learn their rules as you go as each of these words has their own special ability to change the world around you. As the game evolves and ramps up the challenge delight in surprises as the shifting puzzles and introducing new words and unexpected ways they work together to elevate the gameplay.

⬛ Intuitive mechanics and many special words to find and learn
⬜ Elegant, hand-drawn art style and meditative, entrancing soundtrack
⬛ Learn deep, surprising, and unexpected mechanics that simultaneously challenge and delight
⬜ Based on the critically acclaimed puzzle book, LOK

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2207440/LOK_Digital/

If you'd like to support the new game, please consider adding it to your wishlist.

Thanks,
Draknek & Friends

notes.title: Sokobond Express is available today!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to share that Sokobond Express, a beautifully minimalist puzzle game that combines chemical bonds and puzzling pathfinding in novel ways, is out on Steam now. Please enjoy and leave a Steam review!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1701330/Sokobond_Express/

Sokobond Express is developed by José Hernández, a first time commercial developer living in Venezuela. After several years of hard work and refining the game until it felt just right, Hernández is excited for players to finally be able to play it.

“Working on Sokobond Express for the last three years has been a real joy. I think the hardest thing to pull off in the game was the pacing - making levels get progressively harder while remaining engaging took a really long time. We spent a lot of time redesigning early-game levels to make them the perfect difficulty. We're really proud of how things ended up, so please check it out!”- José Hernández

If you’re a fan of other Draknek games, we know Sokobond Express  will be right up your alley. 
It combines the pathfinding of Cosmic Express with the deep but elegant atom building from Sokobond - paying homage to its predecessors while also being an elegant and entrancing game of its own.

Finally, the game is Steam Deck verified. Whether you're playing on Windows, macOS, Linux, or the Steam Deck, the game should provide a native and excellent play experience.

We can’t wait for you to play this puzzle masterpiece.

Thanks,
Draknek & Friends

notes.title: Bonfire Peaks - out now!
notes.content:
Today, in partnership with director Corey Martin, Draknek & Friends is thrilled to announce that Bonfire Peaks is now available, with a 10% launch discount for the first week.

After three years in development the full game is a wonderful experience with over 200 puzzles. If you've played any Draknek game before we know you'll love this as well. Bonfire Peaks is our first foray into game publishing and we couldn't be happier with the result - expect a master class in puzzle design brought to life through beautiful voxel artwork and an atmospheric soundtrack.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147890/Bonfire_Peaks/

Some early reviews:

notes.title: Sokobond is now fully localised into 11 languages
notes.content:
8 years after its initial release, we're very pleased to announce that Sokobond is now available in the following languages:
[list]
[*] English
[*] Français
[*] Deutsch
[*] Italiano
[*] Español
[*] Português (Brasil)
[*] Русский
[*] 中文（简体）
[*] 中文（正體）
[*] 한국어
[*] 日本語
[/list]
Additionally the codebase has been ported from ActionScript 3 to Haxe. Your save file will automatically be copied over and imported to the new version, and you should not notice any differences. However, if you have any issues please let us know on the forums or email us at hello@sokobond.com

And as a final news item, we'd like to draw your attention to an exciting upcoming project: we're publishing a sequel to Sokobond!

Sokobond Express is a mashup sequel to both Sokobond and Cosmic Express, created by upcoming puzzle designer José Hernández and with audio from Sokobond's Allison Walker and writing from A Monster's Expedition's Philippa Warr.

Check it out and wishlist the game here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1701330/Sokobond_Express/

N.B. Sokobond has support for Steam Cloud Saves, but at the time of Sokobond's original release, it did not. That means that if you played Sokobond more than a few years ago and have since changed computers, your savefile may not be available.

notes.title: Draknek's upcoming puzzle game, Bonfire Peaks, coming Q3 2021
notes.content:
Hello puzzle game fans!

We’re excited to announce that Bonfire Peaks, our first publishing venture with developer Corey Martin, will launch later this year in Q3 2021 on PC, Mac, and Linux on Steam. This game lines up perfectly with our portfolio of games like A Monster’s Expedition, and if you’ve liked our past games, we’re confident you’ll love this one too.

[previewyoutube=nlRYgY-Oa30;full][/previewyoutube]

If you’re excited for the game like us and want to get a notification as soon as the game releases, be sure to wishlist the game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147890/Bonfire_Peaks/

Move onwards, move upwards, and leave nothing behind: in Bonfire Peaks, players must climb to the top of a mysterious island ruin, burning everything they own along the way. Featuring hours of masterfully designed puzzle content, a breathtakingly lovely voxel overworld, and not a single second of filler content.

2021 is shaping up to be Draknek & Friends’ biggest year ever, and we can’t wait to share all that we have in store for you.

notes.title: A Monster's Expedition - out now!
notes.content:
[i]A Monster's Expedition (Through Puzzling Exhibitions)[/i], the new game from Draknek & Friends, is now available on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1052990/A_Monsters_Expedition/

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018631/8dd944316309f122ece24e8fdcf66f2095d5c666.png[/img]

I know everyone says this, but I think we've made something really something special that almost everyone will enjoy. The puzzles lead to dozens upon dozens of "a-ha" moments, and vary in difficulty throughout the open world. Anyone should be able to get to the end, but those who are looking for a more difficult experience will be more than satisfied by hundreds of challenging optional puzzles and secrets.

[list]
[*]From the team that brought you the award winning puzzle games Sokobond, A Good Snowman is Hard to Build, and Cosmic Express
[*]Discover new mechanics and solutions organically as you explore - the only tutorial needed is your curiosity.
[*]Chuckle at the "Human Englandland" museum exhibits and the misunderstandings monsters have about humanity.
[*]Sit by the shore to relax or take a coffee break to enjoy the lovely art and music.
[/list]

Thank you all so much for believing in us and following our games. Please let us know what you think of the game by tweeting using the hashtag #MonstersExpedition, or by posting in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/ZkV2zdb]Thinky Puzzles Discord[/url].

notes.title: Twitch Prime's free games for February include Downwell, Dear Esther
notes.content:
Twitch has unveiled the line-up of games that Twitch Prime members can download and keep for nowt as part of their subscription in February: Dear Esther, Downwell, The Flame in the Flood, and Draknek & Co Puzzle Collection.

It's a strong selection of titles, even if most have been around the block a few times. Enjoyable survival adventure The Flame in the Flood, for instance, has already been offered as a Twitch Prime freebie before. If you didn't snag it then, however, it's definitely worth doing so now.

Developed by The Molasses Flood and released in 2016, it delivers a wonderfully atmospheric, and distinctly soggy, twist on the well-worn rogue-lite survival formula. The general gist is that you, along with your trusty canine pal, set forth down a procedurally generated, frequently tumultuous river, stopping off at the occasional island to scavenge supplies, and craft up useful items to keep your perilous journey going just that little bit longer. Eurogamer's Christian Donlan even liked it enough to give it a Recommend badge in his review.

notes.title: Cosmic Express - a new game featuring cute aliens and hard puzzles
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6326584/844dc8b05a7b5d048a758301994ef06cf15a7b94.gif[/img]

Cosmic Express is a puzzle game about planning the train route for the world's most awkward space colony. The train is never big enough, the track can't cross itself, and the aliens are too damn lazy to just walk from A to B!

It's cute, harder than it looks, and guaranteed to give you hours of frustrating fun across hundreds of levels. If you liked Sokobond, please consider checking it out!

Website: https://cosmicexpressgame.com/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/583270

notes.title: A Good Puzzle Game Is Hard To Build
notes.content:
I love puzzle games. But it s not beating them that s the exciting part: it s understanding them.

Whether mulling over a cryptic crossword or somersaulting through Portal s portals, there s a moment of epiphany which, for me, pretty much transcends all other moments in gaming. But how do you design a puzzle to best provoke that eureka moment? What gives a puzzle its aesthetic, its pace and texture? Why does one puzzle feel thrilling while another feels like a flat mental grind?

I ve asked three of my favourite puzzle game designers to demystify their dark magicks: Jonathan Blow, best known for the puzzle-platformer Braid and currently hard at work on firstperson perplexathon, The Witness; Alan “Draknek” Hazelden, creator of Sokoban-inspired sequential-logic games, including Sokobond, Mirror Isles and the forthcoming A Good Snowman Is Hard To Build; and Jonathan Whiting, a programmer on Sportsfriends and collaborator with Hazelden on Traal, whose own games are a regular Ludum Dare highlight.
